positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developing and maintaining web applications. C#, ASP.NET, MVC, Angular, jQuery, CSS, VB, Javascript, SQL

positions.title: Network Engineer
positions.description:
I travel to LAUSD schools and troubleshoot their network problems.
Schools contain a variety of network equipment from different vendors.
Troubleshoot issues with cisco routers, switches, and wireless access points, Alcatel switches, Milan switches and CRM equipment. 3com access points.
Installation and Configuration of  APC and Tripplite UPS with snmp web cards.

positions.title: Pc Technician
positions.description:
Travel to LAUSD school districts and troubleshoot their pc problems.
Install windows operating systems, replace and install hardware.
Troubleshoot and repair the school's network infrastructure (LAN/WAN/Intranet).
Replacing/repair network switches, fiber optic cables, cat5 cabling

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Development of web applications using PERL and PHP that are tightly integrated with databases.
Installation/Maintenance of SQL Server 2000 databases with IIS 5.1
Debugging of existing applications to identify and correct reported bugs
Assist in customer service for online orders, product packaging and shipment.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked with a team of engineers using cgi, perl, php and sql based databases for multiple websites such as www; Worked with mysql databases to store user information, preferences, stock quotes, articles and various other data, create and maintain tables. 
Created an uploader (a cgi program that writes php pages) to allow editors and writers to write a simple text file. The smart uploader would database the article, check for tickers, create a php page for it in the proper directory. It also updated various ftp sites of major portals to provide our content.
Created a webhosting service. Allowed users to sign up with credit card. And had a webpage wizard editor that enabled users to create pages based on templates. Also allowed users to edit/delete/create/upload files to their account.
